RA Domain Analysis Dashboard
=================================

Deployed: December 11, 2025 at 01:54 PM
Location: WageWorks OneDrive

QUICK START:
1. Open index.html to view executive dashboard
2. Navigate sections via quick links
3. Auto-updates when analysis runs weekly/sprint

SECTIONS:
- Managers: KPI tracking, test coverage roadmap, technical debt
- Developers: Onboarding guide, complexity heatmap, knowledge ownership
- Product: Capability catalog, roadmap alignment
- Regulatory: Compliance status, P0 issues tracker

MOBILE ACCESS:
OneDrive app → ASIF → RA-Domain-Analysis → index.html

SUPPORT:
Update toolkit/config/analysis-config.yaml for path changes
